result.instructions: Tools for Cincopa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which videos in our library have no tags yet?"; "Show me every asset in the onboarding gallery."; "Upload this image URL into our media library and tell me its status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cincopa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cincopa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cincopa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cincopa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cincopa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cincopa_check_connection
tools.title: Check API connection
tools.description: Check that the api_token works. Returns the account id, the user id and the permissions the token holds (for example asset.*, gallery.*). Cincopa API: GET /ping.json.

tools.name: cincopa_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List media assets (video, image, audio, other) in the account, with search and filters. Use rid for one exact asset. Cincopa API: GET /asset.list.json.

search.description: Text to search in asset names and metadata.

type.description: Return only assets of this type. Default: all types.

rid.description: Exact asset id (rid). Partial matches do not work.

reference_id.description: Find an asset by your own reference_id.

tag.description: Find assets that carry this tag.

tools.name: cincopa_get_asset_tags
tools.title: List asset tags
tools.description: List the tags used on the account's assets. Use the names with cincopa_list_assets (tag filter). Cincopa API: GET /asset.get_tags.json.

tools.name: cincopa_get_upload_status
tools.title: Get upload status
tools.description: Check the status of an upload started with cincopa_upload_asset_from_url, by its status_id. Cincopa API: GET /asset.upload_from_url_get_status.json.

tools.name: cincopa_list_galleries
tools.title: List galleries
tools.description: List galleries (video collections) in the account, with search and tag filters. Use the fid of a gallery with cincopa_get_gallery_items. Cincopa API: GET /gallery.list.json.

search.description: Text to search in gallery names, descriptions and ids.

filter_tags.description: Comma-separated tags. Return galleries with these tags.

tools.name: cincopa_get_gallery_items
tools.title: List gallery items
tools.description: List the assets in one gallery, by its fid. Cincopa API: GET /gallery.get_items.json.

details.description: Extra metadata fields to return with each item, as the vendor lists them.

tools.name: cincopa_list_live_streams
tools.title: List live streams
tools.description: List the live streams in the account with their state. Cincopa API: GET /live.list.json.

tools.name: cincopa_set_asset_meta
tools.title: Update asset metadata
tools.description: Change the caption, description, tags or reference_id of one asset. Only the fields you pass change. Cincopa API: POST /asset.set_meta.json.

caption.description: New caption (title shown on the player).

reference_id.description: Your own reference id for the asset.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags. Replaces the current tags.

video_thumb_sec.description: Second of the video used as the thumbnail.

tools.name: cincopa_upload_asset_from_url
tools.title: Upload asset from URL
tools.description: Start an upload where Cincopa fetches a public file URL (image, video, audio or document). Returns a status_id; check it with cincopa_get_upload_status. Cincopa API: POST /asset.upload_from_url.json.

input.description: The public URL of the file that Cincopa should fetch.

fid.description: Gallery id (fid) to add the asset to.

rid.description: Asset id (rid) to attach the file to, for example as a thumbnail.

type.description: Type of the attached file, for example thumb.

tools.name: cincopa_delete_asset
tools.title: Delete asset
tools.description: Permanently delete one asset by its rid. The asset is removed from every gallery. This cannot be undone. Cincopa API: POST /asset.delete.json.

tools.name: cincopa_create_gallery
tools.title: Create gallery
tools.description: Create an empty gallery with a name and an optional description. Cincopa API: POST /gallery.create.json.

tools.name: cincopa_set_gallery_meta
tools.title: Update gallery metadata
tools.description: Change the name, description or tags of one gallery. Only the fields you pass change. Cincopa API: POST /gallery.set_meta.json.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags (up to 50). Replaces the current tags.

tools.name: cincopa_add_gallery_items
tools.title: Add assets to gallery
tools.description: Add one or more existing assets to a gallery, at the top or the bottom. Cincopa API: POST /gallery.add_item.json.

rid.description: One asset id (rid), or several separated by commas.

insert_position.description: Where to add the assets (default: vendor default).

tools.name: cincopa_remove_gallery_items
tools.title: Remove assets from gallery
tools.description: Remove one or more assets from a gallery. The assets themselves are kept (delete_assets is always no). Cincopa API: POST /gallery.remove_item.json.

rid.description: One asset id (rid), or several separated by commas.

tools.name: cincopa_delete_gallery
tools.title: Delete gallery
tools.description: Delete one gallery. By default its assets are kept; set delete_assets to true to delete the assets too. Cincopa API: POST /gallery.delete.json.

delete_assets.description: Also delete the assets in the gallery (default false).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cincopa
prompts.description: What you can do with Cincopa here, with example requests to try.
